LanguageData.AteAcklayClaw.stages.ate_acklay_claw.des: These claws are so tender and sweet, the buttery flavour lingers on the tongue.
LanguageData.AteBloddle.stages.ate_bloddle.label: ate bloddle
LanguageData.AteBloddle.stages.ate_bloddle.descriptio: Ah, you can't beat the aroma of cooked bloddle.
LanguageData.AteChakroot.stages.ate_chakroot.label: ate chak-root
LanguageData.AteChakroot.stages.ate_chakroot.descript: What a flavour, there's no mistaking the tangy sweetness of chak-root.
LanguageData.AteChrysalideHeart.stages.ate_rancor_hea: There's something in that meat, I'm staring to feel...Strong!
LanguageData.AteCrustapodRoe.stages.ate_roe.label: ate roe
LanguageData.AteCrustapodRoe.stages.ate_roe.descripti: How beautifully rich and creamy, quite the delicacy!
LanguageData.AteDoshianJelly.stages.ate_doshian_jelly: I can't tell if it's overly tangy or just stinging my mouth. Quite the sensation.
LanguageData.AteFleekEel.stages.ate_fleek_eel.label: ate fleek eel
LanguageData.AteFleekEel.stages.ate_fleek_eel.descrip: This fleek eel flesh is so rich and fatty, quite the delicacy.
LanguageData.AteGorntMeat.stages.ate_gornt_meat.label: ate gornt meat
LanguageData.AteGorntMeat.stages.ate_gornt_meat.descr: That was a really tasty meat. Those Gornt taste great!
LanguageData.AteHawkbatEgg.stages.ate_hawkbat_egg.des: That Hawkbat egg was astonishing. Truly a dish fit for an Emperor.
LanguageData.AteJoganFruit.stages.ate_jogan_fruit.des: Sweet with a crisp texture, it has to be jogan fruit.
LanguageData.AteManaxFungus.stages.ate_manax_fungus.d: Incredible, the fungus flavour is so aromatic and poweful. No wonder they pay so much for this stuff!
LanguageData.AteMeiloorun.stages.ate_meiloorun.label: ate meiloorun
LanguageData.AteMeiloorun.stages.ate_meiloorun.descri: So juicy and refreshing, meiloorun is such a nice treat.
LanguageData.AteMujaFruit.stages.ate_muja_fruit.label: ate muja fruit
LanguageData.AteMujaFruit.stages.ate_muja_fruit.descr: Simply sweet and delicious, muja fruit without a doubt.
LanguageData.AteMunchFungus.stages.ate_muchfungus.des: Munch-fungus has such a pleasant flavor when prepared correctly, it really is very versatile.
LanguageData.AteMunchFungusBread.stages.ate_muchfungu: This Munch-fungus bread is so tasty and filling; just like Mal'aa used to make!
LanguageData.AteNexuTongue.stages.ate_nexu_tongue.des: Mmmm, this meat is delightfully chewy and has such an exotic texture.
LanguageData.AtePaddyFrog.stages.ate_paddy_frog.label: ate paddy frog
LanguageData.AtePaddyFrog.stages.ate_paddy_frog.descr: I swear by the Force the legs of that thing just kicked in my mouth. Made me feel like a Hutt!
LanguageData.AteRawMunchFungus.stages.ate_raw_muchfun: Ixta! This munch-fungus is so spongy and bland. It needs preparing properly!
LanguageData.AteRikknitOvum.stages.ate_rikknit_ovum.d: Despite the pungent aroma, that Rikknit ovum was exquisite.
LanguageData.AteRycritMeat.stages.ate_rycrit_meat.des: That was some delicious meat, it can only have been Rycrit!
LanguageData.AteTachGland.stages.ate_tach_gland.label: ate tach gland
LanguageData.AteTachGland.stages.ate_tach_gland.descr: WHAT was I kriffing thinking?! Simian brains are bitter and disgusting...
LanguageData.AteTenderMeat.stages.ate_tender_meat.des: That meat was very tender and fatty...yum!
LanguageData.AteToughMeat.stages.ate_tough_meat.label: ate tough meat
LanguageData.AteToughMeat.stages.ate_tough_meat.descr: Ugh...That meat was too tough and chewy.
LanguageData.DrankBlueMilk.stages.drank_blue_milk.des: Ah, can't argue with a bit of blue milk...
LanguageData.DrankGreenMilk.stages.drank_green_milk.d: Sithspit! What karking thing made this?! It tastes like it's gone bad INSIDE the animal!
LanguageData.SoothingSong.stages.soothing_song.label: soothing song
LanguageData.SoothingSong.stages.soothing_song.descri: That creature made such a calm and soothing sound, it almost felt like I was dreaming it.
LanguageData.SpatOn.stages.spat_on.label: spat on
LanguageData.SpatOn.stages.spat_on.description: Schutta! That disgusting beast just spat on me!
LanguageData.Webbed.stages.webbed.label: webbed
LanguageData.Webbed.stages.webbed.description: Ah! It's sticky! What is it?
